verdict.rationale: The only first-party scaling claim is a Cloud marketing line promising read high availability through native clusterization. Community comments confirm a replicated version exists only on paid Cloud tiers. The self-hosting docs describe a single binary plus reverse proxy and process manager, with Helm charts for Kubernetes but no documented clustering or replication. Hands-on reports show a single node handling ~80M documents, but other users report unpredictable RAM use at scale and say Meilisearch does not scale beyond one machine. Missing for 10: documented self-hosted clustering/replication/sharding guides, write HA or failover documentation, evidence of deployments at hundreds of millions of documents, and an in-depth scaling path from prototype to large scale.
